description.value: Vice & Virtue Brewing is a craft brewery and kitchen that has anchored Kelowna's North End neighbourhood since 2018, pouring house-made beer alongside a full food menu that includes brunch and a rotating Chef's Table. The taproom has a warm, rustic character with live music series and community events that give it a distinctly local feel. It also offers beer to go, making it a flexible stop whether a cyclist wants to sit down or roll on.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms an active craft brewery and kitchen at 1033 Richter St, Kelowna, with upcoming events listed through May 2026. 'Beer to go' appears explicitly in the site navigation, confirming takeout. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities was found anywhere in the website text, so those fields remain null. OSM name 'Vice & Virtue' is a shortened form of the website's 'Vice & Virtue Brewing Co', flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM name 'Vice & Virtue' is a shortened form; website and legal name appears to be 'Vice & Virtue Brewing Co' — OSM record may warrant a name update.
No phone number present in OSM or on website.
OSM opening hours differ from hours listed on website; OSM data may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Vice & Virtue is a legitimate, active food-and-drink destination well-suited to touring cyclists, but none of the core WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A brief on-site or phone check would resolve these quickly and likely warrant inclusion.
